Part 2&3 人物 PEOPLE

Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field

描述一个你认识的想从事医疗行业的人

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse)

  • When you knew him/her (你什么时候认识他/她)
  • When he/she started to think about that (他/她什么时候开始这样想)
  • What he/she would like to do (他/她想做什么)
  • And explain why he/she would like to choose this career (并解释为什么他/她想选择这个职业)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a person you know who would like to choose a career in the medical field (e.g. a doctor, a nurse)

I'd like to talk about my younger sister, who has decided she wants to build a career in the medical field. She's a few years younger than me, and we've lived together our whole lives, so I know her really well. As for when she started thinking about it, I'd say it was around middle school. I remember she got really interested in biology classes, and she often talked about how much she admired the nurses she saw in hospital dramas and in real life. From then on, the idea just stuck with her. What she'd like to do specifically is become a nurse. She's told me she prefers nursing over being a doctor, because it involves more direct contact with patients, which suits her caring personality. She's currently working hard on her science subjects to get into a good nursing programme, and she even volunteers at a community health centre during holidays. The reason she wants this career, I think, is that she genuinely enjoys helping people. She's always been the kind of person who looks after others, whether it's our family or her friends, and she says nursing lets her turn that instinct into a profession. She also values the stability of the job, since healthcare is always in demand. Looking at her, I can see she's found something she truly believes in, and I'm really proud of her for that.

讲的是我妹妹，她决定从事医疗行业。她比我小几岁，我们从小一起长大。她大概初中时开始有这个想法，那时她特别喜欢生物课，常说自己很佩服电视剧和现实里见到的护士，这个念头就一直留了下来。她想当护士，因为觉得护士和病人接触更多，适合她爱照顾人的性格。她正在努力学理科想考护理专业，假期还会去社区健康中心做志愿者。她选这行是因为真心喜欢帮助别人，也看重这行稳定、社会一直需要。我为她感到骄傲。

Q2Do you think being a doctor is easy or difficult?

I'd say it's one of the most difficult professions, without a doubt. For one thing, the training takes years, and the workload is extremely heavy, with long shifts and constant pressure. Doctors also carry a huge responsibility, since a single mistake can seriously affect a patient's life. On top of that, they have to keep learning throughout their careers, because medicine is always advancing. So while it's a respected and rewarding job, it demands a lot of sacrifice.

医生绝对是最难的职业之一：培训要很多年，工作强度大、轮班长、压力大；责任也重，一个失误就可能严重影响病人生命；而且医学不断进步，要终身学习。虽然受人尊敬、回报高，但牺牲也很大。

Q3Do you think learning biology is interesting for children?

Yes, I think it can be, if it's taught in the right way. Children are naturally curious about living things, like animals, plants and their own bodies, so biology connects well with their everyday experience. When lessons involve experiments or real examples, kids tend to find it fascinating. That said, if it's taught purely from textbooks with lots of memorisation, it can quickly become boring. So the subject itself is interesting, but the teaching method makes all the difference.

可以很有趣，关键看怎么教。孩子天生对动物、植物、自己的身体好奇，生物和日常生活联系紧密；有实验和真实例子时孩子会觉得着迷。但如果只照课本背知识点，很快就会无聊。所以学科本身有趣，教学方式决定一切。

Q4待补充

I think there are several reasons. For many, it's a genuine desire to help others, since caring for sick people gives the work real meaning. For others, it's the stability and respect that come with the profession, since medical jobs are always needed and well regarded in society. Some are also drawn to the intellectual challenge, because medicine requires constant learning and problem-solving. So the motivation is usually a combination of compassion, practicality and ambition.

原因有几个：很多人是真心想帮助别人，照顾病人让工作有意义；也有人看重这行的稳定和受尊重，医疗岗位社会永远需要；还有人被智力挑战吸引，医学需要不断学习和解决问题。动机通常是同情心、现实考量和抱负的结合。
